newsitem.title: USA: Touch Tone America to acquire Arcada.
newsitem.headline: Touch Tone America to acquire Arcada.

text.p: Touch Tone America Inc, a local, long distance and Internet service provider, said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Arcada Communications in a move that could boost annual revenues of the combined operations to $13 million.
Arcada is a privately held long-distance phone service company based in Seattle.
When the deal is completed, Arcada will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Touch Tone America.
